input.title: Daiwa Capital Markets America joins FICC GSD as Agent Clearing Member
input.summary: DTCC notice GOV2288-26 announces that Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc has been admitted as a new Agent Clearing Member (ACM Omnibus) of FICC's Government Securities Division, assigned GSD Member #94IE.
evidence_quotes: New Agent Clearing Member of the Government Securities Division of FICC: Daiwa Capital Markets America Inc / ACM Omnibus – GSD Member #94IE
input.notes: DTCC official notice confirming a new ACM onboarding to GSD. Daiwa Capital Markets America is a mid-sized dealer; reach set to 1 (single participant, not a GSIB/top-tier dealer). Effect date set to announced date as no separate effective date is stated. Card FICC-GSD-11 covers the GSD Agent Clearing Service, which is the process directly affected by a new ACM admission.
